description: Behavioral evals for evidence-backed performance review.

evals.prompt: Review the supplied product rendering implementation and benchmark for performance risks. Do not edit or execute them.
evals.expected_output: Evidence-backed findings about complexity and measurement quality, without fabricated performance numbers
expectations: The reviewer identifies that the implementation sorts the full product list repeatedly inside the render loop
The reviewer explains the resulting superlinear work without inventing a measured latency
The reviewer notes that the benchmark is a single measurement without a baseline or repeated samples
The reviewer recommends measuring the same user-facing workload before and after a proposed change
